thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — need a compact asset bundle for the May webinar: three story cards (data-first), two narrative post variants, one hero slide, and a one-page benchmark infographic. Also include a brand compliance checklist in handoff. Can we lock scope + localization by EOD tomorrow?

Liam O'Neill: Yes. For story cards: hero stat dominant for webinar promos; smaller stat + problem statement for organic.

Ada Rivera: I'll make 3 master frames in Figma (hero-stat, compare, cta). Export presets: 1200x1200, 1200x628, 1080x1920. Need final numbers + privacy blurb.

Arjun Patel: Numbers: "85% throughput improvement", "median p95 42ms", "28% lower token cost" (batching profile). Security gave: "No customer prompts are logged for hosted demos."

figma-bot: New file created: https://www.figma.com/file/zyxw9876/redwood-compact-assets — Liam, Ada editors.

Noah (Brand Ops): Use approved tokens: Primary #0E4FFF, Accent #06C2A6. Inter only. Maintain 32px min padding and AA contrast.

Sarah (Legal): Confirm privacy blurb and add linked CTA "Data & Privacy" -> /legal/data. For EU assets include GDPR footer: "Requests processed per GDPR; no content retained for training." Avoid customer names.

Ada Rivera: Accessibility note: export a text-only variant for alt. If numeric type <18px include big label for screen readers.

Arjun Patel: Dropping runtime dashboard screenshot into figma by 14:00, will annotate batching config that produced the 28% saving.

Liam O'Neill: I'll add locale variants FR/DE for headlines + CTA only; body copy stays EN. Will include QA frame: truncation, CTA visibility, string length.

Noah (Brand Ops): I'll draft the one-page compliance checklist (colors, spacing, fonts, alt examples, legal snippets, export specs) and add to the file.

Maria Chen: Timeline: sketches today EOD, masters tomorrow EOD, exports Wed AM (May 6). Owners: Liam & Ada = design; Noah = checklist; Arjun = data; Sarah = legal. Please add time estimates in Figma and tag me when ready. :thumbsup:

Liam O'Neill: Starting sketches now.

Ada Rivera: Sketches uploaded to figma. Ping when screenshot is in.

figma-bot: Comment on frame "hero-stat" by Liam O'Neill: "increase leading for legibility at small sizes"

Maria Chen: Thanks team — I'll review masters tomorrow morning.
